candidates.name: Plumefist
candidates.lore: Too heavy to fly and too proud to care. It settles every argument with its legs, and it starts most of them.

candidates.name: Snapshell
candidates.lore: The tide brings it up and forgets to take it back. It holds the beach with one great claw and never learned to let go.

candidates.name: Clankball
candidates.lore: It rolls downhill at anything that moves and uphill at anything that doesn't. The smiths say the plates ring in a key they can't forge.

candidates.name: Silkmaw
candidates.lore: It spins in the dark and waits for the dark to be crossed. The skull on its back is the last thing many travellers read.

candidates.name: Twineback
candidates.lore: Not a monster, exactly. A man who took to the hedgerows and now takes from everyone who walks them.

candidates.name: Pyrelord
candidates.lore: The mountain's first king, and its only one. Every eruption since has been him clearing his throat.

candidates.name: Rimehulk
candidates.lore: The blizzard walks on two legs up there. Climbers hear it breathing through the snow long before the snow turns red.

candidates.name: Boglurk
candidates.lore: Only the gills show above the mud, red as flowers. Pick one and the rest of it comes up smiling.

candidates.name: Hollowplate
candidates.lore: The knight left long ago. The armor kept the vigil, and the fire that keeps it standing has forgotten whose it was.

candidates.name: Veilmother
candidates.lore: She searches every cradle in the valley and finds none of them hers. The cold that follows her is the closest she gets to company.

candidates.name: Stormroc
candidates.lore: It nests above the weather and hunts below it. Every thunderclap on the fells is a wingbeat somebody did not see.

candidates.name: Pebblet
candidates.lore: A pebble that pinches. Beachcombers learn which stones to skip the hard way.

candidates.name: Mosscoil
candidates.lore: Too slow to chase anyone and too stubborn to move aside. Its shell is a garden and it defends the garden.

candidates.name: Rootfather
candidates.lore: Older than the road that was cut around it. It has forgiven the axe once, and says so, and will not do it twice.

candidates.name: Cragtroll
candidates.lore: It sleeps as a hillside and wakes as a landslide. Travellers who camp on it are the reason it wakes.

candidates.name: Duststing
candidates.lore: It sleeps under the dune and wakes under your boot. The sting comes first; the pincers only keep you still for it.

candidates.name: Rimetail
candidates.lore: It leaves no tracks and takes the warmth from a fire by sitting near it. Hunters call it the cold's own dog.

candidates.name: Magmaslug
candidates.lore: It moves a hand's width a day and melts the road behind it. Patient things kill the most travellers.

candidates.name: Thornhog
candidates.lore: The hedge got up and charged. Its back is a bramble patch and the berries are the only thing that has ever calmed it.

candidates.name: Snaggle
candidates.lore: It takes what it can carry and runs. It is never alone; the rest of the warren is a whistle away.

candidates.name: Hexgob
candidates.lore: It reads the future in bog-gas and finds it favorable. Its curses work about half the time, which is enough.

candidates.name: Marrowbolt
candidates.lore: It cannot see and does not miss. The arrows are older than the bow, and the bow is older than the wall.

candidates.name: Rotwalker
candidates.lore: The field was his, then the plague was. He still turns the soil each morning; it is the only thing he remembers.

candidates.name: Gravemaw
candidates.lore: It eats what the graves give up and waits for more. Its patience is only hunger, drawn out.

candidates.name: Hootclaw
candidates.lore: Half of it hunts by night and half by day, and they never agreed to sleep. It is always awake, and always hungry.

candidates.name: Gearwarden
candidates.lore: Wound once by a hand long dead, it has not run down. It guards a door that no longer has a room behind it.

candidates.name: Flarewisp
candidates.lore: It burns because it is, not because it must. It follows travellers for the company and leaves them as ash.

candidates.name: Tideheart
candidates.lore: A river that stood up to see what it had been carrying. It is not angry, but it has never learned to be gentle.

candidates.name: Dreadmage
candidates.lore: It refused death to finish its work. The work is finished. It has not stopped.

candidates.name: Hexcrone
candidates.lore: She trades in wishes and collects in years. Every village has one story about her, and every story ends the same.

candidates.name: Cudgel
candidates.lore: Toll is whatever you carry. Refuse, and the club decides what you leave with.

candidates.name: Scaleblade
candidates.lore: Its people ruled the marsh before the marsh drowned them. It still patrols the borders of a country that is gone.

candidates.name: Skulkfang
candidates.lore: It was a man when the moon was thin and forgot how when it filled. The apron is from its old trade; the cleaver is new.

candidates.name: Moonrend
candidates.lore: It runs the ridge under every full moon and comes back fed. The village no longer asks what it ate.

candidates.name: Stonewing
candidates.lore: It kept watch from the chapel eaves for centuries. When the last bell fell silent, it came down.

candidates.name: Stonegaze
candidates.lore: Meet its eyes and become a landmark. The roadside is lined with people who did, still pointing the way.

candidates.name: Snaptrap
candidates.lore: Planted to keep the pests from the garden. It has grown past pests, and past the garden.

candidates.name: Tuskbelly
candidates.lore: Master of the ice shelf. The tusks settle every dispute over it, and there has never been a second one.

candidates.name: Blubberling
candidates.lore: Everyone who sees one wants to pick it up. Its mother is the reason nobody does it twice.

candidates.name: Inkling
candidates.lore: It has three hearts and holds a grudge in each. The ink is how it says goodbye.
notes: agent eyeball: the ink cloud under the body is baked into every facing and reads like a ground shadow in play — the game draws its own. Re-roll without the ink if you want it.

candidates.name: Lurelight
candidates.lore: It crawled out of the deep for a brighter lure and found lanterns. It follows every light on the shore now.

candidates.name: Slagfist
candidates.lore: The mountain's own fist. Where it strikes, the ground splits and the fire comes up.

candidates.name: Magmatoad
candidates.lore: It basks in the lava as other toads bask on stone. Its croak carries sulphur and its bite carries fire.

candidates.name: Duneblade
candidates.lore: It guarded a tomb until the sand took the tomb. Now it guards the sand, and the sand keeps taking.

candidates.name: Wrapwarden
candidates.lore: Its name was carved off the tomb, so it went looking for it. It checks every face and none of them fit.

candidates.name: Hoodfang
candidates.lore: It sways so you will watch the hood. The bite comes from where you were not watching.

candidates.name: Foxfire
candidates.lore: Three tails, three lies, and one truth it will tell you for a price you will not like.

candidates.name: Pebblemite
candidates.lore: It is a pebble until it isn't. Cairns are made of them, and cairns move at night.

reasons: south: content touches the canvas edge (clipped)

candidates.name: Rimemite
candidates.lore: It bites once and the bite never thaws. Snow-walkers check their boots every night for good reason.
